neighbours.label: a retort that repeats a word from the claim it answers ('can't be wrong. Well yes they can!', 'No, it makes sense to ...')
fire: Ten thousand fans can't all be fools. Well yes they can!
Does it help to call that dog lazy? No, it helps to call that dog tired.
Experts say it won't work. Oh yes it will!
"You can't lift that box." "Of course I can."
Is it fair to blame the driver? No, it is fair to blame the company.
They told me I couldn't win. But I could, and I did.
Would it matter if we left early? Yes, it would matter a great deal.
Everyone thinks the rule is silly. Well, it is.
quiet: Ten thousand fans filled the park. They sang all night!
Does it help to call that dog lazy? Most owners walk their pets at dusk.
Experts say it won't work. The trial begins in June!
"You can't lift that box." "Ask your brother for help."
Is it fair to blame the driver? The hearing starts on Tuesday.
They told me I couldn't win. So I went home for dinner.
Would it matter if we left early? The bus stops near the bridge.
Everyone thinks the rule is silly. The mayor will speak soon.
